act: Uniform Guidance, 2 CFR part 184 (Buy America preferences for infrastructure projects)
location: 2 CFR 184.6(a)(4); Build America, Buy America Act, section 70915(b)(2)(A)

en.title: 2 CFR 184.6(a)(4): how does the fiber optic cable standard implement the statutory requirement for input manufacturing?
en.summary: Section 70915(b)(2)(A) of the Build America, Buy America Act directs OMB to ensure that its standards require that each manufacturing process required for the manufacture of the construction material and its inputs occurs in the United States. For fiber optic cable, 2 CFR 184.6(a)(4) requires ribboning (where applicable), buffering, fiber stranding and jacketing in the United States. It includes the glass and optical fiber standards and excludes the standards for non-ferrous metals, plastic and polymer-based products, and other materials. The 2023 preamble explains why OMB treated the cable as a single construction material with its own standard. One reading treats the listed processes as the definition Congress delegated to OMB. The other asks whether the manufacture of polymer and other non-fiber inputs before jacketing is also required.
en.impact: No project or product with a different result has been established. Excluding another material's standard does not by itself show that a required process was omitted.
en.correction: Please clarify how the starting points in 184.6(a)(4) and the treatment of non-fiber cable inputs implement section 70915(b)(2)(A).
